title: Annual Amazon deforestation in Brazil

source.name: PRODES Amazon deforestation monitoring
source.publisher: INPE (Brazil's National Institute for Space Research)

notes: Annual forest-clearing area in the Brazilian Legal Amazon per INPE's PRODES satellite monitoring program, compiled via trade press (Mongabay, Reuters) for years between official year-end reports; 2004, 2019, 2023 and 2024 figures are the official PRODES totals, other years approximate.
